standards_claimed: Class 1 Laser International Safety Standard IEC 825
notes: Datasheet is for L9-SD312M-20TTC5 (SM, 1310 FP, 20 km, 5 V, 0 to +70°C per Order Information). Supply 3.3 V or 5.0 V supported; optical tables at VCC 3.3 or 5±0.2 V. Data rate stated as DC–2 Mbps, 500K–2000 Kbps, not in Gbps. Optical power and sensitivity per Note1–2: launched into 9/125 μm SMF at 2 Mbps. Industrial SKU L9-SD312M-20TTI5 is -40°C to +85°C; not this order code. Series features mention up to 2 km on 62.5/125 μm MMF and up to 40 km SMF for other types. Output spectral width (RMS) max 4.0 nm. Supply current Icc max 160 mA (not power in W).
suggestions: Consider bit_rate_kbps or bit_rate_mbps for sub-Gbps modules. form_factor enum could include 1x9. emitter_type for this SKU is explicitly FP in Order Information; series text also lists VCSEL/FP.
